description: Phase 0 capture overview — power, cadence, page mix, and channel events for one or more capture sessions.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ant_power_only")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "power_w")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.capture_id =~ /${capture_id:regex}/)

from(bucket: "${INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ant_power_only" or r._measurement == "ant_crank_torque")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cadence_rpm")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.capture_id =~ /${capture_id:regex}/)

from(bucket: "${INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ant_page_count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.capture_id =~ /${capture_id:regex}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5s, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["page_name"])

panels.title: Page mix (counts per 5s, by page name)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ant_manufacturer" or r._measurement == "ant_product_info" or r._measurement == "ant_battery")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.capture_id =~ /${capture_id:regex}/)
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

from(bucket: "${INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ant_calibration" or r._measurement == "ant_channel_event" or r._measurement == "ant_acknowledged")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.capture_id =~ /${capture_id:regex}/)
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: false)

title: Phase 0 Capture Overview
